steps.text: Rhodes Island Landship
Dormitories, outside Gavial's room

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Good morning, Gavial, it's time to get up.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (She's not here...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (That's really weird. Did Gavial wake up early today?)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Maybe she's eating breakfast already. I'll check the cafeteria.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Gavial's not here either...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (She's not sleeping, and she's not here eating.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (She probably had something important to do today.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (I don't think she had any field missions coming up, so the only place she can be is Medical.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Whuh—huh?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wh—what's going on?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I only overheard it from my other colleagues.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We had an emergency call last night from a nearby settlement. It's a complex situation.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We had to send out an accompanying Operator with both combat and medical experience to ensure the other operators' safety.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: And out of the whole department, Gavial's the best fit for times like these.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The mission really was urgent. Every Operator who took up the call for deployment headed out right away.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Why... what's...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She probably left you something, right? A message, a slip of paper, the sort.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Let me look!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Turns on comms terminal)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: N—Nothing!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But why...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Ever since we left Acahualla, she—she's never come to say hello...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial couldn't have... couldn't have abandoned me again, right?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Er, you're overthinking it...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'll go help her right now!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Wait, wait, wait, hold on! How are you gonna get there? Walk?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I... I'll drive over!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Settle down. You need to get permission from the motor pool, not to mention you don't know where you're going.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: And that's before we get to the part where you don't know how to drive.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I—I could...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Uwh—wuhh...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: W-What are you crying for...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, come on, quit it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whimper*...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I know you're worried for Gavial.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But you oughta know. It's Gavial, what's to worry about?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No one could ever lay a finger on her.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm scared she'll... get... get a graze...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She's a Medic Operator. She can cure wounds like that herself just fine.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But, what if she—

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, alright, you weeping here isn't gonna solve anything, is it?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Just go back and rest for a bit, settle your emotions, and do something to cheer yourself up, okay?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It was an urgent mission, but it's nothing tough. Give her, maybe, three, four days to her triumphant return.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Don't scare yourself.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: O—Okay...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm sorry for being such a pain...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No harm done, ha ha. Go on, head back and relax.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I will...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I didn't think going Gavialless would hit her so hard.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Must've left a deep impression on her when Gavial up left home the first time.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I've gotta remind Gavial, you tell your loved ones before you go.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Or else we'll get a repeat of this. What if Tomimi cries the department six feet under water?
Something that sad could happen?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Take a seat, Blue Poison. Are you feeling unwell anywhere?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial's out on a mission...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I want to go on a mission with Gavial too.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Do something to cheer myself up...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What should I do? Is there anything I can do?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If only I could be as strong as her...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Where—am I?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm lost in Rhodes Island again. If Gavial finds out, she'll bonk me...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Someone's over there. Maybe I can ask her.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um. Hello?

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Hello, Archosauria. Is there anything I can assist you with?

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: (Graceful curtsy)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wuh, uwh-wah.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Imitates the curtsy)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hello, could I bother you to tell me where I am?

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: If you mean your specific position, we're in a corridor to the Rhodes Island hangar.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Thank you, Miss Liberi!

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Make no mention.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: You seem as though—you're a little bewildered. Do you need my help?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm lost...

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Ah, I see.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Where did you lose your way?

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: I'm sorry, I seem to have asked a silly question.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Ahem—in that case, where do you want to go?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I want... to buy a fashion magazine. I haven't read one in a long time, since leaving Acahualla. I'm feeling the itch.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: A magazine, hmm. I understand.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: If you want to buy magazines, take the elevator there up two floors, then turn right when you come out and go straight; after you see the little fountain, turn left, and you'll find a bookstand.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: The prices might be a little higher than in the city, but they have stable suppliers, a varied selection, and you can order in any publications you'd like.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alright. Thank you, I'll go take a look right now.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Just wait one moment.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Before you leave, could I hassle you to assuage a small doubt of mine?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Um, you can just ask, no need to be so polite.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Very good, I'll keep that in mind~

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Archosauria, does the burden on your shoulders weigh on you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Burden? You mean my backpack?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Weighs backpack in hand)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's alright, it's not that heavy.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's all my specially selected treasures inside. I need to keep them close to me.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Can't you put them in your dormitory? That's your little slice of home at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But I'd be really sad if I ever lost it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I can't let even one thing go missing. I'm better off keeping it with me.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Your recollections, your keepsakes, hmm...

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Have you ever thought of putting them in a safe?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No, no way!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: My treasures will be angry if I lock them in a box!

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Well, then, give your dormitory a proper furnishing, and turn it into your very own museum. Maybe that'd be nicer?

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Knowing to bear your recollections is a good thing, but perhaps in learning to unload burdens and adorn them, there's more significance still.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, I don't really, get what you're saying.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: It's nothing. Just a solitary Liberi's meaningless soliloquy.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: My question has already found an answer. Thank you.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Do you want me to guide you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No, it's okay, I think I can find my way! Thank you!

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Then I'll bid farewell, Archosauria.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: Perhaps we'll meet again very soon.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: (Sargonian dialect) May your outlook be as boundless as the great forest.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: (Graceful curtsy)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (She looks like she's really in a hurry.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Is that Liberi at the other end her sister?)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (They seem really close.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (That's so nice.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (I've reached the tiny fountain. Turn left...)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And this should be it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Waah, Rhodes Island has stalls like this too?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: It's your first time shopping at ours, isn't it?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: The store's too cramped, and sometimes when we can't fit all our stock, the stall comes out. Of course, it's all approved and filed on record in advance. There's no shady business here.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: What are you looking to buy?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I wanna buy the latest fashion magazine.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Fashion magazines come in many varieties. See, ones for getting into pendants and jewelry, ones putting out celebrity news, ones for announcing what's trendy in clothes, and—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Please give me the ones about clothes, thank you.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: This one's... all sold out on the latest issue.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (I'm having the worst luck today...)

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But you're in luck. The Operator who bought the last copy's still here. If you really want to read it, you could go ask her if she'd be willing to share with you.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Which one is she?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Over there, the one with pink hair.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: She's called Blue Poison, and she's the first in to buy magazines every time. Seems she got held up today, and almost missed out.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Go give her a shout. She'll share with you, I think—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alright, thank you!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Wait, I'm not done, she—

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Whatever, sometimes less is more.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Maybe Blue Poison'll make a new friend this way.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: H—Hello... would you happen to be Blue Poison? I'm Tomimi.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (So this is Tomimi? What a fine coincidence.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Holds out hand)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: You want... to shake hands with—me?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, I just thought, um, it's the polite thing to do and...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If you don't want to, then—

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (Shakes Tomimi's hand)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I'm Blue Poison. I'm very happy to meet you.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Because of... reasons... most people aren't too happy to—make contact—with me.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: So I was surprised when you held out your hand. Sorry for that.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Did you need something from me?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I want to borrow your magazine to read a little, is that okay? I'll give it right back.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Magazine? You mean this issue of Me Maze?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm sorry, my Victorian isn't too good, so I can't read the words here so well.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I only just picked it up, so I haven't read it yet.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: There's too many people around. Let's find somewhere to sit down and have a read at our own pace.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay, I'll follow you.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm done reading.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Thank you, Blue Poison.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hm? Oh, no problem.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Miss Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You can just call me Tomimi. Adding a title to a code name is a little weird...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Ah, alright, Tomimi.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: This morning... what happened?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: An operator at Medical said you could've cried the whole department six feet under water.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's... kind of embarrassing to say.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: You'll feel better getting it out. Give it a try.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Well, it's like this...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That's the whole story, more or less.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Please don't laugh at me...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Of course I wouldn't.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: You know, I've heard that Archosauria never shed tears.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Tears are a sign of weakness, so you can never, ever cry in front of anyone else.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But even so, you'll still cry for Gavial.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: And there's nothing embarrassing about it at all.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ohh, thank you.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I see you have an interest in clothing and fashion magazines. Does your homeland have such publications too?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No, but sometimes Inam would bring some from the outside for me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: She's the one who does business in our place, so she always brings interesting stuff back. She taught me the outsiders' languages.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: After I learned them, I bought books from her to read, and I really liked the stuff in some of them, so I kind of ended up reading more.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Such as?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: City Beauty and other ones like that.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Mm-hm, that was a fairly notable fashion magazine for sure.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But... their works have been too streamlined, too cookie cutter. They've definitely lost a lot of their mystique... *sigh*...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I hear a few editors and photographers of theirs want to jump ship and set up their own shop. Who knows yet if that'll come to anything.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You really, really know a lot about fashion, Blue Poison. You're incredible...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Not quite. I just read around, and have some of my own tastes and opinions, that's all.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: How about you, Tomimi? What is fashion to you?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm not too sure. My mother tongue doesn't have the vocabulary to talk fashion.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It has plenty for hitting people, though.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hahah...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I think, fashion is probably nice-looking clothes, and simple and pretty jewelry.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Acahualla doesn't have anything like that.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The first time I opened that magazine was the first time I learned clothes could come in colors like that, and designs like that.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Some clothes I probably couldn't ever imagine in my life, but someday or other, they'd appear in the magazines Inam was selling, and I could say for sure—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: —I really liked those clothes.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: There you go. I'd call you knowledgeable any day.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Actually, the clothes I'm wearing right now are from when I saw some I really liked in a magazine, so I worked on making the whole outfit and adjusting it myself.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Although it's a little rough...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Ah, I think it's ringing a bell...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (Opens and flips through her own personal notepad)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: MARTHE... Mad Wild... Fury's Call... Swimming Suit series... Coral Coast...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Found it.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Take a look. Was it this outfit?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, it was!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: How do you know it?!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: It's in my collection. Sometimes, if I meet with a design I particularly like, I'll cut it out and stick it in this notepad, and then write my own gains from it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Y—You cut them out? Won't that ruin the magazine?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: It's—how do I put it... I suppose it's a personal habit of mine.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Cutting and pasting magazine pictures does spoil the print's intactness, but to me, it's a shortcut.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Shortcut?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Taking all the knowledge you want most from a magazine, and putting it in one place.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: And through that shortcut, it ends up in here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: In your head?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: This notepad I'm holding is my sixth one already.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I only ever pull out the first few to flick through when I want to feel nostalgic.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Inside them, save for memories, there's nothing left at all.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: The truly important things have all gone into my brain.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: They've become my aesthetics, tastes, styles.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Can brains really remember that much?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Of course not. What's left behind is only the parts you least want to forget.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Such as, your choices and aspirations for beauty.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Or maybe, in your case, um—

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Gavial?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, you're right. I definitely couldn't forget Gavial.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: The most important memories, they're always in your head.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Sometimes, things are just keys for opening them up.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Once you consolidate the memories and they're like an automatic door, you'll never need the key again.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That... that makes sense.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Keys... treasure...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Memories...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Tomimi, have you ever tried styling outfits before?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Styling? No, not yet.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Then let's go to the shops and try on some clothes, what do you think?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Try them? Can—can I?!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Though the selection's not as complete as stores in the big cities, I can take you to experience it at least.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If you don't mind, I can take us to visit a tailor, to get you even more style suggestions.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I—is that—really something you can do?!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Of course. If you want, we can even have a whole outfit custom-made for you here at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (Small mutter) Although the prices aren't too customer-friendly...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: O—Okay, I, uh, I, I'll get ready.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We're gonna try on clothes in a moment, right?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Then I—I, I need to put my backpack in my dorm first, and then it'll be less tricky when I'm trying them on.

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: The fact you've gained awareness of this is something worth celebrating, you know.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah, it's Miss Liberi from just before!

steps.name: Passerby Liberi
steps.text: I forgot to introduce myself previously. Do forgive me for my negligence.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Astesia Urbica. Most usually call me just Astesia.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hello, Miss Urbica.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Holds out hand)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Elegantly shakes hands)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Good afternoon, Miss Urbica.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Good afternoon, Blue Poison.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I want to take Tomimi to try on some clothes. If you could—

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: As luck has it, I want to pick out some new clothes for myself too. It would be my greatest pleasure to go with you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: As for Bibeak, I wager she's still at the bookstand, buying the print.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oh, my. It seems I wagered correctly.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (You really can't get anything past her...)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I'll go give Bibeak a heads-up.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: See you in a bit.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) Astesia, Miss Urbica!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) What's the matter?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) You said before, about furnishing into a museum. How do I really do that?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) Here. See that little water fountain?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) Mmhm.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) There's a sculpted relief on top of it. Isn't it pretty?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) Mmhm.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) If that fountain was your own meticulously preserved piece, would that make you feel, well, delighted?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) Um... mmhm!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) And that's the way it works.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) Placing beautiful memories on pedestals specially made for them—it always has the power to cheer oneself up.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) If you need it, you can install further equipment on the pedestals too. You can protect things from outside damage, and greatly extend their lifetimes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) That sounds pretty good.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Hushed) Then, if, if you have time, could I ask you to, help me, um, plan it out?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) Of course.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hushed) Choosing decor has its own particularities. When you're done trying on clothes, we can take our time with research.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: For now, we'll go meet up with Blue Poison and her friends. It would never do to keep them waiting.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What is it, Miss Urbica?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Do you feel in a better mood now?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Doing what I like—makes me really happy.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oh, that's wonderful.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Let's go, then.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The difference between Rhodes Island and Acahualla is kind of big.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: There's a lot you can't do here, and the rooms are pretty small.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But I don't mind it that much.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I can learn so many new things, and make new friends.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: There's nothing that makes me happier.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Maybe I can become a fashion expert, or an explorer, or a Caster.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Or maybe a fashionable Caster with an exploring spirit?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And what fun stuff might happen in the future?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'm really looking forward to it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I guess when Gavial chose to stay at Rhodes Island, and not in Acahualla, this was why.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I wonder what Gavial's up to now?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hold still! It'll just hurt for ONE moment.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Ow, gentle, you're killing me!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I said it'd hurt, not kill you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: All bound up. You put some pressure on that wound, and I'll give our guests a warm welcome.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah!
Urgh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey! What's with these punks creeping up here?

steps.name: Field Captain
steps.text: Sorry, Gavial! We only let that one guy slip, the others are all done and dusted!

steps.name: Field Captain
steps.text: Everyone, rest up where you are, and stay vigilant!

steps.name: All Field Operators
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Phew. It's finally over.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yep. Long as you're all alright.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: You had real short notice for this mission. Did you ever send your hometown friend any regards?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What regards am I gonna give? I know her.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Not sure about anyone else, but the one who keeps coming to Medical, same race as you, right? You could at least give her a shout.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: What if she didn't find you, and cried Rhodes Island under water?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Us Acahualla expats are all strongest of the strong. Tomimi sure as hell isn't that weak.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Besides, I ran some work with Astesia pretty recently. Anything happens, and she'll be there to help manage, guaranteed.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Fine, yeah, you got it all worked out already. Pretend I never asked.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Less yapping, more helping me figure the post-mission out. Where are we linking up with the R.I. landship?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Oh, yeah, one sec.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Um... here.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Landship'll be calling at this city for rest and resupply.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Hear it's a holiday city too. Giant coastal beach in there, wide open to tourists.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Thinking what I'm thinking? We can take a vacation.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doesn't that work out.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (Holiday city... coastal beach?)

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (How about I buy her an outfit for the waterside? She oughta like that.)

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (Yeah. Call it an apology.)
